headline: Thermax Shares Fall 20% to 52-Week Low Following Weak Q2 Results
summary: Thermax shares plunged 20% to a 52-week low after reporting a decline in second-quarter net profit to ₹114.54 crore, prompting a sell rating from brokerages.
why: Industrial equipment manufacturers' earnings misses signal slowing industrial capital expenditure and execution challenges in executing order books.

impacts.name: Thermax
impacts.why: Lower net profits and weak quarterly numbers directly depress the company's share price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
